title: Shader Programs
summary: In-place L0 program cache: one linked GPU program per vertex/fragment shader-resource pair, shared by the materials made through it, linked when both stages are ready and relinked after a context loss.
dependencies: engine material/nt_program_ref.h: links one pair and drops it on context loss
engine nt_material: materials borrow the cached program
provides: shader_program_material: a material bound to its pair's shared program
shader_program_ready: whether a material's program can draw
shader_programs_update: links ready pairs and re-points their materials
shader_programs_restore_gpu / shader_programs_shutdown: drop the programs after a context loss or before gfx shutdown
